Priya: quick postmortem follow-up  we need a small project to knock out alert noise and tighten paging. main scope: dedupe 502 bursts, adjust cpu autoscale alerts, add deploy suppressions, and publish a nighttime paging matrix. owners below. pls ack with ETA.
Ken: I can own the prometheus rules + dedupe behavior. thinking a 10m dedupe window for 502s and add `instance` to the grouping so single-host spikes don't page. aiming to open PR by Wed.
Aria: Ill take paging policy + suppression rules. plan: only page for severity=critical OR sustained `for >= 10m`. add `no_page` label for chatty warnings. draft by Thu.
Noah: Ill update runbooks and add an ops play for "502 storm" (steps, mitigation, sample queries). linking GH issue when created. ETA next Tue.
Priya: ops-bot should surface recent pattern: 14-day history shows 9 separate 5xx spikes clustered around deploys. can we include a `suppress_during` tag that references deploy windows?
ops-bot: Automated: 5xx spike pattern detected (last 14d = 9 events). Top upstream: payments-proxy. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.local/d/alerts/5xx-patterns
Ken: prometheus draft (staging first):
```
alert: Outbound5xxBurst
expr: increase(http_responses_total{status=~"5..",route!="/healthz"}[5m]) > 60
for: 3m
labels:
  severity: warning
  dedupe_window: "10m"
  group_by: "job,instance"
annotations:
  runbook: "https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/blob/main/runbooks/502-storm.md"
```
Grouping by `instance` and a longer dedupe_window should collapse host-level flurries.
Aria: for paging matrix I'll include who to page 00:00-08:00 vs 08:00-24:00 and an escalation list if initial ack > 15m. also will add a rule to suppress pages during scheduled deploy tags.
Noah: created GH issue #859 to track runbook + paging + infra changes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/issues/859. Added checklist and assigned tasks.
Priya: assigning final owners & due dates: 
- Ken: prometheus rule + grouping + dedupe change (due: Wed COB)
- Aria: paging policy + suppress_during tag + matrix (due: Thu COB)
- Noah: runbook + ops play + sample queries (due: next Tue)
Ken: acked, will include test plan for staging and a rollback.
Aria: acked, will post draft to #eng-oncall for feedback.
Noah: acked, will attach runbook to GH issue and ping oncall for review.
Priya: please update the postmortem follow-up tracker when you make progress. Ill run weekly check-ins until all items closed. ping me or @pagerduty if blocked. :white_check_mark:
